title: Elexnova Technical Insights article payload
description: Contract used by the n8n automation to create or update one article in the Technical Insights content center. The payload is validated by scripts/technical-insights/add-article.js before anything is written.

slug.description: URL file name without extension. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only. The article URL becomes https://elexnova.com/news/<slug>.html

title.description: Editorial title. Rendered as the visible <h1>, the breadcrumb and the Article headline.

shortTitle.description: Optional shorter stem for the browser/SEO <title> tag: `<shortTitle|title> | MiDEN Electronics`. Use it when the editorial title is too long for search results.

summary.description: One or two sentence summary shown on the hub card, the RSS item and the articles.json index.

lead.description: Optional opening paragraph HTML placed directly under the H1.

body.description:
Article body HTML. Use

for sections,

for paragraphs,

    /
      for lists and for internal links. At least two

      sections are required.

updated.description: Optional last update date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the publish date.

category.description: Editorial category. Must match one of the categories defined in assets/data/technical-insights.json.

keywords.description: Focus keywords. Written to <meta name="keywords">, the Article schema and the on-page keyword list.

takeaways.description: Optional key takeaway bullets rendered in the highlighted box above the table of contents.

author.description: Optional author name. Defaults to 'MiDEN Engineering Team'.

products.description: Optional related product links as [label, href] pairs, for example ["Power Inductor Series", "../products/power-inductor.html"].

internal.description: Optional extra internal links as [label, href] pairs, for example ["Solar Inverter Magnetics", "../industries/solar-inverter.html"].

related.description: Optional slugs of related Technical Insights articles shown in the 'Continue reading' block.

status.description: published keeps the article in the hub, sitemap, feed and articles.json. draft renders the page as noindex and hides it from all listings.
